bio: Overlooking Shakespeare’s Globe and Tate Modern, The Westin London City is nestled in the heart of the City of London, just a stone's throw away from St Paul's Cathedral.  Indulge in Afternoon Tea served at Mosaic, with this dining venue boasting scenic views of the Thames. Feast on a delightful selection of finger sandwiches, including options such as Butter-roasted chicken with Goji berries & coriander, Nori-baked salmon & pickled cucumber, and Dorset beef & horseradish crème fraiche. Relish traditional scones accompanied by clotted cream and jam, alongside an assortment of irresistible pastries like JING matcha cake, Multi-layer honey cake, and Nutella & berry tart.  Afternoon Tea at The Westin London City is served every day from 1pm to 5pm and costs £45 per person, or £60 per person with a glass of Taittinger Champagne.
